en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a tall white minaret and adjoining religious complex seen from a narrow street lined with low stone houses. At the top it bears multilingual text identifying it as a souvenir from Salonique (Thessaloniki) and naming the Church of Saint Catherine, which was later used as a mosque (Mosquée Ski Cherrifé). The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, and there is a small website attribution at the bottom.
